findings.summary: env singleton built at module import time defeats DI/fail-fast tests that need to feed a custom source
findings.suggested_fix: Keep loadEnv() factory; defer singleton construction to a buildApp/main bootstrap, or lazy-init via `let _env; export const getEnv = () => _env ??= loadEnv()`.

findings.summary: Subclass constructors repeat Object.setPrototypeOf already executed in AppError base ctor via new.target.prototype
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the trailing `Object.setPrototypeOf(this, new.target.prototype);` line from each subclass constructor (errors.ts L47, L57, L67, L77, L87, L97, L107); the base ctor already handles it.

findings.summary: pino redact wildcard `*.password` matches one nesting level only; deeper paths like req.body.user.password are not redacted
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit deep paths (e.g. `req.body.user.password`) or use pino's `**.password` style only if compatible. Pair with a unit test asserting nested payload redaction in wave-7+.

findings.summary: PasswordHasher.verify(hash, plain) parameter order is non-conventional; most ecosystems use verify(plain, hash)
findings.suggested_fix: Keep current order (matches argon2 lib's verify(digest, password)); ensure auth.service callers and test spies in wave-7+ assert the documented order. No code change required.

findings.summary: UserId branded type duplicated across apps/api/shared/ids.ts and packages/contracts/src/auth.ts (zod brand) without a shared bridge
findings.suggested_fix: Document in conventions or have shared/ids re-export the zod brand from @medbridge/contracts so call sites use one canonical UserId type.
